main_text.l: noniae episcopum, homines ad humanam generis perniciem natos,Acatianum à Cæsarea,Asterium, Eusebium Nicomedensem episcopum, qui Constantinnm Magnum & Constantium baptizauerat,propterea̛que in aula imperatoris gratiosus erat. Theogonium Nicenum episcopum,& alios penè infinitos, inter quos etiam omnium Historicorum consensu,Liberius Romanus Episcopus recensetur, ne quis Romana Ecclesiam errare posse neget.è quibus tamen ipsis quidam occultè, quidam autem apertè Arium defenderunt, ut mirum appareat in ea re Satanæ opus. Persequuti sunt autem Ariani or-thodoxos longè tetrius & durius quàm ulli unquam Pagani fecerant, ut scribit Socrates libro 5.cap.13.& Sozomen.libr.6.cap.37.Theodoret. libr.2.histor. cap.8. Latissimè verò propagata hæc hærefis, etiam perstitit diutissimè, ut scribit Socrates libro 6.cap.8.quando nec nunc quidem tetræ & amarę ipsius radices exscindi extirparíque è mundo potuerūt. Mahumetani enim sunt huius infelicis stirpis stolones,& nunc quoque plus quàm 1500.post primum ipsius ortum annos,inter Christianus(proh blasphemia) nomine Serucetanorum,Dauidicorum,Syluanista-rum,Blandratarum, Nearianorum repullulat. Floruit autem plus quàm 8o. annos publicè in Ecclesia recepta,uti apparet ex epist.Constatin. cōcilij ad Damasum, & nisi Deus per paucos quosdā orthodoxos episcopos,veluti per Athanasiū,magna sua misericordia hoc venenū repressisset,fidē Christiana,& verā de Christi dei

page.notes: Printing error kept as printed: "Constantinnm" (for Constantinum). Hyphenated line-end words kept with printed hyphens: "or-thodoxos", "Syluanista-rum", "Episco-pum" as printed "episco- pum". Words split across lines without a printed hyphen were joined whole: "generis", "Asterium", "exscindi extirparíque" (joined from "extir paríque"). "cōcilij ad" is printed with no space in the line ("cōcilijad"); transcribed as printed with a space after "cōcilij" as read from the line end. Long s has been normalised to plain s and u/v to the printed-vowel/consonant forms as instructed. The text "recepta" had a Cyrillic-looking letter in the scan; written in Latin letters.
